on_the_bluffs.name: The Bluffs
on_the_bluffs.note: Only one source (Thunder Bay season roughly May-Oct, bugs); MP chart not readable. Unconfirmed.

ab_heart_creek.name: Heart Creek
ab_heart_creek.note: SummitPost: driest rock-climbing time is Jun-Sep, nobody climbs there in winter; Gripped says summer is peak with good shoulder-season weather; another guide May-Sep. Shared window Jun-Sep.

co_rotary_park.name: Rotary Park
co_rotary_park.note: Madboulder: best bouldering Mar-May and Sep-Nov, summer hot with afternoon storms; Collegian guide warns of midday summer heat. A listing site claims Jan-Sep (not used).

sd_cathedral_spires.name: Cathedral Spires
sd_cathedral_spires.note: Season words only (late spring through early fall; SummitPost spring-fall); no months named.

ar_jamestown_crag.name: Jamestown Crag
ar_jamestown_crag.note: No season named; MP notes hot humid July and seepage after rain. Unconfirmed.

ca_lee_vining_canyon_tioga_road.name: Lee Vining Canyon / Tioga Road
ca_lee_vining_canyon_tioga_road.note: HELD by reviewer: window taken from a neighbouring area or a road opening, not this area's climbing. Sources are about the neighbouring Tuolumne/Tioga Road granite: core Jun-Sep, Sep-Oct praised, Tioga Road closed about Nov to late May/Jun (NPS). Applied to this Tioga Road area by proximity, not area-specific text.

ut_long_canyon.name: Long Canyon
ut_long_canyon.note: Mountain Project: south-facing walls perfect mid/late fall to mid/late spring; BLM asks climbers to avoid the canyon Apr 1-Jun 15 (bighorn sheep), so spring is trimmed to Mar. Summer heat.

wa_exit_32_little_si.name: Exit 32 / Little Si
wa_exit_32_little_si.note: MP North Bend & Vicinity: season Apr to mid-Oct, best June, consistent climbing shut down Nov-Mar by rain; KAYA: late spring through early fall.

me_acadia_national_park.name: Acadia National Park
me_acadia_national_park.note: Season words only (late spring through early fall; Apr-Jun rainy/buggy); NPS peregrine closures early Apr-mid Aug on some cliffs. No month-naming source.

mt_stone_hill_2.name: Stone Hill
mt_stone_hill_2.note: Spring destination (south-facing, climbed early April), South Sector falcon closure late Mar-early Aug; no full month range.

ns_mainface.name: Mainface
ns_mainface.note: No source about this Nova Scotia crag found.

in_muscatatuck_park.name: Muscatatuck Park
in_muscatatuck_park.note: Only a forum opinion (Oct to late April); MP lists the park closed to climbing. Unconfirmed.

me_a_western_mountains.name: Western Mountains
me_a_western_mountains.note: MP page has no season; guide blogs say late spring to early fall (words only).

on_ontario_south_bouldering_and_rock.name: Ontario South Bouldering and Rock
on_ontario_south_bouldering_and_rock.note: Region too broad; no month-naming source found.

on_the_swamp.name: The Swamp
on_the_swamp.note: No source found for this crag.

wa_stuart_range.name: Stuart-Enchantments
wa_stuart_range.note: Prusik/Colchuck sources give May-Sep (one May-Oct, Colchuck Jun-Sep, Stuart Jun-Aug); shared window Jun-Sep; early season snow, permits needed.

wv_lower_meadow.name: Lower Meadow
wv_lower_meadow.note: thetopo: best fall to spring, well shaded and manageable in summer (words only); NPS New River Gorge proxy not used.

co_mt_evans.name: Mt. Blue Sky (formerly Mt. Evans)
co_mt_evans.note: HELD by reviewer: window taken from a neighbouring area or a road opening, not this area's climbing. MP Summit Lake pages: easy access limited to June-September by summit road closure; CODOT: summit road open Memorial Day to Labor Day. Window is access-driven but is the practical rock season at 10,000+ ft.

md_patapsco_valley_state_park.name: Patapsco Valley State Park
md_patapsco_valley_state_park.note: No season text found; The Nest stays damp after rain.
